description.narrative: The Operation's IPF Windows will assist the Government of Punjab to develop its housing sector policy, strategy, and programs; to strengthen the institutions and systems needed to facilitate housing supply; and to undertake program management. Specifically, it will support activities such as: a) development of evidence-based housing policy, strategy, and programs; b) implementation of recent regulatory reforms to support housing delivery; c) digital systems for housing market information, projects' management, and beneficiary management; d) locational and infrastructure provision criteria and processes to facilitate the PforR window; and e) institutional strengthening of HUDD, PHATA and the Urban Unit through requisite staffing and fiduciary, safeguards, and M&E systems.
To support the Government of Punjab in strengthening its housing institutions and systems, and enhancing the quantity and quality of affordable housing supply.

condition.narrative: 1. Operations Manual: FA, Section I.C.1.b of Schedule 2: The Implementing Entity to, within one (1) month after the Effective Date,ensure that PHATA and UU adopt such Operations Manual as shall have been approved by the Association and thereafter, implement theOperation in accordance with the Operation Manual.

2. Program Steering Committee: OA, Section I.B.1 of the Schedule: The Implementing Entity to maintain, throughout the period ofimplementation of the Operation, a Program Steering Committee, comprised of officials of various government entities, in adequatenumbers, and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association, vested with the responsibility of overseeing theimplementation of the Operation in their respective agencies to: (a) provide policy guidance and direction for the Operation; (b)address any cross-cutting implementation challenges; (c) review progress reports; and (d) verify APA reports.

3. Disbursement of funds: OA, Section I.B.5 of the Schedule: The Implementing Entity to ensure that annual disbursements intendedfor PHATA are fully integrated into the Implementing Entity's provincial budget, and released to PHATA.

4. Independent Verification Agent: OA, Section I.B.6a of the Schedule: The Implementing Entity to select, notify and engage by theearlier of the date which is nine (9) months after the Effective Date and the first date on which the Implementing Entityundertakesa verification, and subsequently maintain throughout the period of implementation of the Operation, the services ofIndependent Verification Agent(s) with qualification and experience and under terms of reference acceptable to the Association, inorder to: (i) support the Operation's monitoring and evaluation; and (ii) document the achievement of DLIs/DLRs.

5. Limitation on Direct Contracting: OA, Section II(d) of the Schedule: The Implementing Entity to ensure that the Program willexclude any activities which involve Direct Contracting which is more than fifteen (15) percent of Program's annual procurementvalue. The fifteen (15) percent limit will be determined cumulatively, applied to all contracts entered into in that year.

6. Annual Work Plan: OA, I.C(b) of the Schedule: Annual work plan for the first year of Project implementation, shall be furnishedto the Association by not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date.
